name: Mohammad Haseeb
bio: Mohammad Haseeb brings sales and day-to-day operations together, keeping the property search, paperwork and handover moving in the same direction. His focus is straightforward: a clear next step for the client and a team that follows through.

name: Mohd Shahid Khan
bio: Ensures smooth day-to-day office operations while managing the company's IT systems and digital infrastructure. Coordinates administrative processes, streamlines workflows, and provides reliable technical support to keep the business running efficiently.

name: Issaadi Chahrazed
bio: Specializes in Dubai's off-plan properties, helping clients identify high-potential investment opportunities. Provides expert advice on new launches, payment plans, and market trends to help buyers make confident decisions.

name: Talha Shabbir
bio: Talha Shabbir is the first conversation behind new relationships at SWK. He helps turn a broad property brief into a practical discussion about location, budget and timing, connecting clients with the right consultant and keeping communication clear from the outset.

name: Fareed Choudhary
bio: Fareed Choudhary helps buyers look beyond a striking photograph. His approach centres on how a home will actually work: the layout, the neighbourhood, the ongoing costs and the questions to settle before making an offer. He supports clients through shortlisting, viewings and the next steps toward purchase.
